title: abfc project configuration (abf.config.json)
description: Settings of one abfc project. Keys that abfc does not know are ignored.

schemaVersion.description: Layout of this file. 2 today; absent means 1 (older asset path rules).

mod.description: The mod this project builds. Switching the target mod is a change of mod.name.

name.description: Name of the mod, for example ExampleMod.

dir.description: Machine-specific folder of the mod. Discouraged here: put it in the user config.

sourceRoot.description: Project-relative folder that holds the class files. Asset paths derive from the folders below it.

classManager.description: The class-manager table the project refers to.

table.description: Mod-relative path of the class-manager data table.

classes.description: Engine or game class paths to generate stubs for.

scriptClasses.description: Script class paths (/Script/Module.Class) to generate stubs for.

modAssets.description: "all" for every Blueprint of the mod, or a list of mod-relative asset paths such as "Relays/BP_Example".

widgetMembers.description: Deprecated: members are found by abfc generate. Designer widgets of widget Blueprints that cannot be read from an export: class path to { member name: widget class path }.

backend.description: How abfc reaches the Mod Editor.

minProtocol.description: Lowest backend protocol version this project needs.

serverDir.description: Machine-specific backend folder. Put it in the user config.

python.description: Machine-specific Python executable. Put it in the user config.

editor.description: Machine-specific editor settings. Put them in the user config.

root.description: Machine-specific folder of the Mod Editor.

headlessDir.description: Machine-specific folder for headless runs. Put it in the user config.

modsDir.description: Machine-specific folder that holds the mods. Put it in the user config.

protectEditorEdits.description: true: abfc build refuses (ABFC5019) to remove or replace what was made by hand in the Mod Editor; abfc build --replace-editor-edits lets one build do it. Default false (TypeScript wins, ABFC5014 warning).
